notes.title: Motorcycle Night Ride – Full Release Roadmap & Ride Up
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Night Riders!

First of all, we want to give a huge thank you to everyone who has played the game, shared feedback, written reviews, and supported us since launch. [/p][p][b]Motorcycle Night Ride[/b] was developed by a small team with a big dream — and it’s thanks to you that we’ve come this far.

Throughout the process, one thing has always guided us:[/p][p]"We want players to feel like they're on this journey with us."[/p][p]That’s why today, we’re excited to share with you our upcoming [b]V1.0 (Full Release) Roadmap[/b].

The items listed below are based on a mix of your suggestions and our vision for the game.

Each one is designed to make the ride smoother, more fun, and a richer experience overall.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310544/429f5eeeae6c897866ca672a85b69dffb1ba6f18.png"][/img]
[b]So, what else is going on?
[/b][/p][p]We’re also working on something completely new:[/p][p]Say hello to our next game — [b]Ride Up[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We describe Ride Up as a [b]story-driven, atmospheric platforming experience[/b].[/p][p]
Blending cinematic storytelling through environmental design and inner monologues with puzzle and parkour elements, we believe it will bring something truly original to the genre.[/p][p][/p][p]So while we continue improving [b]Motorcycle Night Ride[/b], we’re also laying the groundwork for a brand-new journey.[/p][p]
And the great news is: [b]Ride Up is now live on Steam for wishlisting![/b] 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752520/Ride_Up/"][/dynamiclink]
Your wishlist click means a lot. It helps us reach more players and ensures you’ll be the first to know when it launches! 💙


[b]Your Feedback Means Everything[/b][/p][p]Your comments, Steam reviews, Discord conversations they all matter to us deeply. It’s been an amazing experience to build this with you.
[/p][p]Please keep sharing your thoughts and ideas — because we’re building this game together.

Thanks again, Night Riders.

Keep riding into the night. 
[/p][p]With love,
[b]The Suber Game Studio Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Early Access V0.3 Update
notes.notes:
-Game modes section has been added.
Players will now select the game mode they want to play before selecting a map.

Game Modes;

[b]-Free Ride[/b]
A free play mode not based on any score.

[b]-Close Pass[/b]
A competitive game mode where players can score points depending on how close they are to the vehicles, combo on consecutive passes and get higher scores. They will be able to compete with other players with the upcoming Ranking Table.
